narrative: Teams can now declare Copier modules in their repo overlays — GitWeave renders and commits them atomically via the Git Trees API with no pull request. The `gw plan` command shows what would be added or updated before any write occurs; `gw apply` commits the rendered files directly to the default branch; `gw overlay status` reads back the per-module answers file to confirm what is applied. A policy layer enforces which modules each team may request via `gw overlay request`. The rulesets 403 split ensures plan failures name the real cause — unsupported org plan versus missing token permission — so operators act on accurate information.
